name: media-downloader
title: Media Downloader
description: Download video and audio from YouTube and hundreds of other sites with yt-dlp, with per-site settings
author: woysful

commands.name: video
commands.title: Video
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Download a video. Keys: -f container, -q max height, -yt yt-dlp format selector, -ff ffmpeg args, -a extra yt-dlp args, -p whole playlist, -e [codec] re-encode for video editors, -ea [codec] re-encode the audio track

commands.name: audio
commands.title: Audio
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Download audio only. Keys: -f audio format, -yt yt-dlp format selector, -ff ffmpeg args, -a extra yt-dlp args, -p whole playlist

commands.name: video-best
commands.title: Video Best
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Download a video in the best available quality without remuxing or re-encoding. Keys: -p whole playlist, -a extra yt-dlp args

commands.name: audio-best
commands.title: Audio Best
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Download audio in the best available quality and convert it to WAV. Keys: -p whole playlist, -a extra yt-dlp args

commands.name: download
commands.title: Download Media
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Download form with all options: type, quality, container, re-encode codec, playlist and custom yt-dlp/ffmpeg arguments

commands.name: downloads
commands.title: Download List
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Running and recent downloads with progress: cancel, open the file, download again or read the log

commands.name: cancel
commands.title: Cancel Download
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Stop all downloads started by Media Downloader and remove their partial files

commands.name: configure-domains
commands.title: Configure Domains
commands.subtitle: Media Downloader
commands.description: Open the per-domain settings file (domain-config.txt), creating it with documentation if needed

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Directory
preferences.description: Where files are saved. Empty means your XDG download folder (usually ~/Downloads)

preferences.name: defaultVideoFormat
preferences.title: Video Container
preferences.description: Container for the Video command. MP4 is the safest choice for video editors

preferences.name: defaultQuality
preferences.title: Video Quality
preferences.description: Preferred maximum resolution. A lower resolution is used only when the video has nothing at or below it

preferences.name: reencodeCodec
preferences.title: Video Re-encode
preferences.description: Re-encode every Video download with this codec. Choose No re-encode to leave videos untouched by default; -e and reencode domain rules still work and fall back to H.264. The result always has a constant frame rate. ProRes and DNxHR are editing codecs (large files); GPU encoders fall back to the CPU if they fail

preferences.name: reencodeAudioCodec
preferences.title: Audio Re-encode (video files)
preferences.description: Re-encode the audio track of Video downloads with this codec. The video stream is copied unless a video re-encode is also selected. Choose No re-encode to keep the original audio

preferences.name: reencodeExtraArguments
preferences.title: Re-encode Extra Arguments
preferences.description: ffmpeg output arguments appended to the codec preset, e.g. -crf 16 or -preset slow

preferences.name: defaultVideoSelector
preferences.title: yt-dlp Video Format
preferences.description: Default yt-dlp format selector (-f) for the Video command

preferences.name: defaultAudioFormat
preferences.title: Audio Format
preferences.description: Format for the Audio command

preferences.name: audioQuality
preferences.title: Audio Quality
preferences.description: Quality for lossy audio formats

preferences.name: embedMetadata
preferences.title: Embedding
preferences.label: Embed metadata (title, artist, date)
preferences.description: Write title, uploader, date and description into the file

preferences.name: embedThumbnail
preferences.label: Embed thumbnail
preferences.description: Embed the video thumbnail as cover art (MP4, MKV, MOV, M4A, MP3, Opus, FLAC)

preferences.name: cookiesFromBrowser
preferences.title: Cookies From Browser
preferences.description: Use the login cookies of a browser for age-restricted, private or members-only videos

preferences.name: extraArguments
preferences.title: Extra yt-dlp Arguments
preferences.description: Arguments added to every download, e.g. --limit-rate 5M or --sponsorblock-remove sponsor

preferences.name: outputTemplate
preferences.title: File Name Template
preferences.description: yt-dlp output template for single downloads

preferences.name: playlistTemplate
preferences.title: Playlist File Name Template
preferences.description: yt-dlp output template used with -p

preferences.name: customDomainConfig
preferences.title: Domain Config Directory
preferences.description: Directory containing domain-config.txt. Empty means ~/.config/media-downloader. Use the Configure Domains command to edit it

preferences.name: ytdlpPath
preferences.title: yt-dlp Executable
preferences.description: Custom yt-dlp binary. Empty means the one on PATH, or a copy downloaded automatically

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Executable
preferences.description: Custom ffmpeg binary. Empty means the one on PATH

preferences.name: autoUpdateYtdlp
preferences.title: Maintenance
preferences.label: Update the downloaded yt-dlp daily
preferences.description: Runs yt-dlp -U at most once a day. Only affects the copy downloaded by this extension, not a system installation

preferences.name: progressNotification
preferences.title: Progress
preferences.label: Show progress in a desktop notification
preferences.description: Keeps one notification updated with the download progress, so it stays visible after the Vicinae window is closed (Linux, uses notify-send)

preferences.name: notifyOnCompletion
preferences.title: After Download
preferences.label: Desktop notification
preferences.description: Send a desktop notification when a download finishes or fails

preferences.name: openFileManagerAfterDownload
preferences.label: Show the file in the file manager
preferences.description: Reveal the downloaded file in the file manager after a successful download
